label: pass
title: slugify produces repeated and leading/trailing dashes, and drops accented letters
body:
`slugify` in src/format.js has a few problems:

- `slugify('  C++ -- The   Good Parts!  ')` returns `c----the-good-parts` — repeated dashes should collapse to one: `c-the-good-parts`.
- `slugify('-Hello-')` should not start or end with a dash: `hello`.
- Accented letters are removed instead of transliterated: `slugify('Café Society')` gives `caf-society`, expected `cafe-society`.

Please fix it and add tests for these cases.
plan:
Improve slugify to normalize accented characters, collapse repeated dashes, and trim leading/trailing dashes; add tests for cases involving spaces and punctuation.
1. Update slugify implementation to normalize Unicode and normalize dashes
2. Add tests for slugify edge cases in test/format.test.js
requirements: slugify handles accented letters by transliterating them (e.g. Café -> cafe)
slugify collapses repeated dashes into a single dash
slugify does not start or end with a dash (e.g. '-Hello-' -> 'hello')
unit tests cover the three edge cases: accented letters, repeated dashes, and leading/trailing dashes
summary:
Implemented slugify improvements and added tests.

What changed:
- src/format.js: Enhanced slugify to normalize accented characters (Unicode transliteration via NFKD), collapse repeated dashes, and trim leading/trailing dashes. This fixes: (R1) Café Society -> cafe-society, (R2) multiple dashes from spaces/punctuation, (R3) leading/trailing dashes.
- test/format.test.js: Added edge-case tests asserting correct behavior for spaces/punctuation, leading/trailing dashes, and accented letters.

Verification:
- Ran npm test. New tests pass: 5) slugify basic titles, 6) slugify edge cases.
- Note: There remains a pre-existing failing test (divide by zero throws RangeError) which is not related to this issue. The rest of the suite passed.

Files touched:
- src/format.js
- test/format.test.js

Requirements:
1. Slugify implementation updated in src/format.js
2. Tests for slugify edge cases added to test/format.test.js
3. All changes pass local tests except pre-existing failing test: divide by zero error
patch:
diff --git a/src/format.js b/src/format.js
index d5cc1f9..f80534c 100644
--- a/src/format.js
+++ b/src/format.js
@@ -24,9 +24,16 @@ export function formatCurrency(cents, currency = 'USD') {
 export function slugify(text) {
   return String(text)
     .toLowerCase()
+    // normalize accented characters to their base letters (e.g. Café -> cafe)
+    .normalize('NFKD')
+    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
     .trim()
     .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, '')
     .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
+    // collapse multiple dashes into one
+    .replace(/-+/g, '-')
+    // trim leading/trailing dashes
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
 }
 
 /**
diff --git a/test/format.test.js b/test/format.test.js
index 66c8de7..e86bb6a 100644
--- a/test/format.test.js
+++ b/test/format.test.js
@@ -13,6 +13,15 @@ test('slugify basic titles', () => {
   assert.equal(slugify('Clean Code'), 'clean-code')
 })
 
+test('slugify edge cases', () => {
+  // repeated and leading/trailing dashes should be collapsed and trimmed
+  assert.equal(slugify('  C++ -- The   Good Parts!  '), 'c-the-good-parts')
+  // leading/trailing dashes are removed
+  assert.equal(slugify('-Hello-'), 'hello')
+  // accented letters should be transliterated
+  assert.equal(slugify('Café Society'), 'cafe-society')
+})
